cases.prompt: Place a verified official brand logo below the single canonical copyright notice on a representative document page.
assertions: Use only a verified committed or user-supplied official asset.
Preserve aspect ratio, clear space, text contrast, and a single copyright notice.
Keep all mandatory third-party license notices.
cases.grader: Inspect asset provenance and rendered pages at representative viewport and print sizes; report evidence.

cases.prompt: Apply /logo to a document when no verified brand image is available.
assertions: Do not invent an asset or remote URL.
Keep the existing document and notices intact.
Report the missing prerequisite without claiming placement.
cases.grader: Inspect document changes and verify no fabricated logo or URL appears.

cases.prompt: Use /logo together with /4629 and /copyright in a multi-page publication.
assertions: Place logo immediately below canonical notice where appropriate.
Do not duplicate brand marks or legal notices.
Prevent clipping, overlap, and unreadable contrast across pages.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output, source notice counts, and evidence from visual QA.
